correctness.rationale: Reconstructed uniqueness by synchronous update coupling and a fixed positive-probability contraction word on a rooted spanning tree. A regular midpoint decreases D by (x_i-x_j)^2/2; an anchor update increases D by at most 5R^2. Stationarity and the precise weighted Laplacian gap give E D<=10 epsilon B R^2/lambda_2. Conditioning on anchor selection in the generator (rather than treating a nonstationary embedded anchor sequence as autonomous) yields scalar approximate stationarity; the affine perpetuity kernel contracts W1 by 1-1/(2N), giving the stated exact bounds. The variance and sequential symmetric +/-1 normal limit follow from independent weighted bounded variables and Lindeberg. Fixed-N and update orientation assumptions are essential. Inspected full RESULT.md and verify_gossip.py, which constructs independent first/second-moment linear equations; did not execute source code or treat its 290 asserted checks as independent validation.
